_: BOB-26 (D-079 addendum, Gate 0 findings): THE ONE canonical source of Gate 3's Supabase Auth settings. The app reads the code's validity and the password rules from here (src/lib/pengaturan-auth.ts); staging.yml writes these keys to staging and reads them back; identity-facts.yml fails when a project's deployed value differs; supabase/config.toml carries the same values for the local and CI stack, and a static test fails if they drift. Change a value here and everything follows it. production_applied becomes true in the release commit that applies them to production (C-11); until then production's differences are reported, not failed.

config_toml._: Where each setting lives in supabase/config.toml. The last two have no key there (the CLI does not map them); PINTAR's own guard (the password write permit, migration 20261112100000) refuses a direct change on every stack regardless.
